% ============================================================
%  preamble.tex — shared styling for all chapters
%  Class Notes Template — Indigo & Saffron design
%  Do not edit per-chapter. Edit once here; every chapter inherits it.
% ============================================================

% ---------- Fonts ----------
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{charter}
\usepackage{helvet}
\usepackage{microtype}

% ---------- Page geometry (twoside for book binding) ----------
\usepackage[a4paper,top=2.4cm,bottom=2.4cm,inner=2.8cm,outer=2.0cm,
            headsep=0.7cm,footskip=1cm,headheight=21pt]{geometry}

% ---------- Indigo & Saffron palette ----------
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{Ink}{HTML}{1E1E2C}          % Deep Charcoal — body text
\definecolor{Accent}{HTML}{3B3486}       % Royal Indigo — headings, primary accent
\definecolor{AccentWarm}{HTML}{D4882B}   % Saffron — note borders, labels, highlights
\definecolor{AccentDark}{HTML}{2C2866}   % Deeper Indigo — table headers
\definecolor{Grey}{HTML}{6B6E7B}         % Slate — metadata, page numbers
\definecolor{Hairline}{HTML}{C9C6DE}     % Lavender Mist — rules, dividers
\definecolor{Tint}{HTML}{FBF8F2}         % Ivory Cream — note background
\definecolor{SaffronLight}{HTML}{F5E6C8} % Light saffron — subtle accents
\color{Ink}

\usepackage{setspace}
\setstretch{1.18}
\usepackage{parskip}
\setlength{\parskip}{5pt}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\usepackage{needspace}

% ---------- Headings ----------
% \chapter   = one lecture / topic  (Royal Indigo + saffron underline)
% \section   = sub-topic            (Ink, bold, indigo number)
% \subsection= sub-sub-topic        (Indigo, bold italic)
% \paragraph = run-in named label
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]
  {\color{Accent}\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{20}{24}\selectfont}
  {\color{Grey}\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont\MakeUppercase{Chapter \thechapter}}
  {6pt}{}
  [\vspace{4pt}{\color{AccentWarm}\rule{0.14\textwidth}{1.8pt}\hspace{6pt}\color{Hairline}\rule{0.06\textwidth}{1.2pt}}]
\titlespacing*{\chapter}{0pt}{0pt}{22pt}
\titleformat{\section}{\color{Ink}\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{13}{16}\selectfont}
  {\textcolor{Accent}{\thesection}}{9pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{18pt}{8pt}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\color{Accent}\sffamily\bfseries\itshape\fontsize{11}{13}\selectfont}
  {\textcolor{Grey}{\thesubsection}}{7pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{12pt}{5pt}
\titleformat{\paragraph}[runin]{\sffamily\bfseries\itshape\fontsize{10.5}{12}\selectfont\color{Accent}}{}{0pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\paragraph}{0pt}{6pt}{4pt}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{2}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{2}

% ---------- Table of contents: indigo accents ----------
\usepackage{tocloft}
\renewcommand{\cftchapfont}{\sffamily\bfseries\color{Accent}}
\renewcommand{\cftchappagefont}{\sffamily\color{Grey}}
\renewcommand{\cftsecfont}{\sffamily\color{Ink}}
\renewcommand{\cftsecpagefont}{\sffamily\color{Grey}}
\setlength{\cftbeforechapskip}{10pt}
\setlength{\cftbeforesecskip}{2pt}
\renewcommand{\cftchapleader}{\cftdotfill{\cftdotsep}}
\renewcommand{\cftdot}{\textcolor{Hairline}{.}}

% ---------- Lists ----------
\usepackage{enumitem}
\setlist[itemize,1]{leftmargin=18pt,labelsep=6pt,topsep=3pt,itemsep=3pt,
                    parsep=0pt,label={\textcolor{AccentWarm}{\textbullet}}}
\setlist[itemize,2]{leftmargin=16pt,labelsep=6pt,topsep=2pt,itemsep=2pt,
                    parsep=0pt,label={\textcolor{Grey}{\textendash}}}
\setlist[enumerate,1]{leftmargin=18pt,labelsep=6pt,topsep=3pt,itemsep=3pt,parsep=0pt}

% ---------- ONE unified note style — saffron border, ivory background ----------
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\tcbuselibrary{breakable}
\newtcolorbox{note}[1]{
  enhanced, breakable, sharp corners, boxrule=0pt,
  colback=Tint, borderline west={2.2pt}{0pt}{AccentWarm},
  left=10pt, right=10pt, top=6pt, bottom=6pt,
  before skip=10pt, after skip=10pt, width=\textwidth,
  fontupper=\fontsize{10.4}{13.5}\selectfont\color{Ink}
}
\newcommand{\notelabel}[1]{{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{8.3}{10}\selectfont\color{Accent}
  #1\par\vspace{3pt}}}
\newenvironment{KeyConcept}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{KEY CONCEPT}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{DataFact}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{DATA \& FACTS}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{GovtPolicy}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{GOVERNMENT \& POLICY}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{CriticalPoint}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{CRITICAL POINT}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{ExampleBox}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{EXAMPLE}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{ComparisonBox}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{COMPARISON}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{PYQLink}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{PREVIOUS YEAR QUESTION}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{QuickRevision}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{QUICK REVISION}}{\end{note}}
\newenvironment{ChapterGlossaryNote}{\begin{note}{}\notelabel{CHAPTER GLOSSARY}}{\end{note}}

% ---------- Tables: indigo header row, saffron midrule accent ----------
\usepackage{tabularx,array,booktabs,colortbl}
\newcolumntype{Y}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.35}
\newcommand{\thead}[1]{{\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont\color{white} #1}}

% ---------- Divider ----------
\newcommand{\sectiondivider}{\par\vspace{8pt}\noindent
  \textcolor{Hairline}{\rule{\textwidth}{0.5pt}}\par\vspace{8pt}}
\newcommand{\rupee}{\textrm{Rs.}\,}

% ---------- Header / footer: book-style odd/even ----------
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{lastpage}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\headrule}{\hbox to\headwidth{\color{Accent}\leaders\hrule height \headrulewidth\hfill}}
% Even (left) pages: page number on left, book title on right
\fancyhead[LE]{\sffamily\fontsize{8}{10}\selectfont\color{Grey}\thepage}
\fancyhead[RE]{\sffamily\fontsize{8}{10}\selectfont\color{Grey} \HeaderLeftText}
% Odd (right) pages: chapter name on left, page number on right
\fancyhead[LO]{\sffamily\fontsize{8}{10}\selectfont\color{Grey} \hyperref[toc]{\nouppercase{\leftmark}}}
\fancyhead[RO]{\sffamily\fontsize{8}{10}\selectfont\color{Grey}\thepage}
% Footer: centred page X of Y
\fancyfoot[C]{\sffamily\fontsize{7.5}{9}\selectfont\color{Hairline} \thepage\ / \pageref{LastPage}}
\renewcommand{\chaptermark}[1]{\markboth{\MakeUppercase{#1}}{}}
\renewcommand{\sectionmark}[1]{\markright{#1}}
% Plain style (chapter-opening pages): no header, centred page number
\fancypagestyle{plain}{%
  \fancyhf{}
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
  \fancyfoot[C]{\sffamily\fontsize{8}{10}\selectfont\color{Grey} \thepage\ / \pageref{LastPage}}
}

\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

% ---------- EDIT THIS: running header left text ----------
\newcommand{\HeaderLeftText}{\hyperref[toc]{UPSC Sociology Paper 2}}
